claims.finding: The fixed universal p-quasi-isogeny trivializes every prime-to-p tensor lattice. Finite discrepancies are locally constant; actual compatible at-p Hecke witnesses meet every component and preserve all tensors simultaneously. Thus the same b has all tensor equalities and its inverse remains the period marking.

fixed_marking_quantifiers: One universal algebraic b is fixed before alpha, ell and n; every finite discrepancy for that b vanishes, and ell-adic separation gives exact equality. No independently chosen local b is substituted.
